experiment: E3 force-law exponent p in a ~ r^p for a 1/r^2 ray source with a short closed third dimension

standard_theory.source: Newtonian gravity of the visible mass; flat rotation curves need p = -1 at large r (v^2 = a r constant)

observation.flat_curves: v(r) constant to within ~10 percent beyond a few kpc in most disc galaxies (Rubin, Ford & Thonnard 1980, ApJ 238, 471; Bosma 1981; SPARC: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016, AJ 152, 157)
observation.effective_exponent: p about -1 in the flat regime; radial acceleration relation (McGaugh, Lelli & Schombert 2016, PRL 117, 201101): g_obs = g_bar/(1 - exp(-sqrt(g_bar/g_dagger))), g_dagger = 1.2e-10 m/s^2, i.e. transition from p = -2 to p = -1 at fixed acceleration, not at fixed radius

model_prediction_derived_from_documents.statement: HYPOTHESES 6 / relativity-probes sec.5: with one dimension closed at period L, a 1/r^2 ray transport spreads in 3D for r < L and in 2D for r > L: p = -2 inside L, p = -1 beyond L, transition radius = L itself, no extra mass.
model_prediction_derived_from_documents.lattice_plan: gravity-probe held-body configuration (exchange coupling, momentum += mass x flux / D) with a golden-spiral ray source, held bodies at r = 3..24 on the in-plane axes and face diagonals; boxes: periodic [S,S,3], [S,S,5], [S,S,9] slabs (S wide enough that no ray laps in the window), open [S,S,S] cube control, and an open [S,S,3] slab (leaky) control. Fit log(pull) vs log(r) per box over r >= 6 and, for the period-9 slab, separately r < 9 and r > 9.
model_prediction_derived_from_documents.expected: closed slab depth 3: p = -1.0 +/- 0.3 for all r >= 3; open cube: p = -2.0 +/- 0.3; open slab: p steeper than -2 (rays leak); period 9: p near -2 for r < 9 and near -1 for r > 9

pass_fail.code_pass: momentum closed (carrier + field = 0) in every world; every pull points toward the source; no ray has lapped the box within the measurement window
pass_fail.model_candidate_falsified_if: the closed-slab exponent is not within 2 sigma of -1 or the open-cube control not within 2 sigma of -2, or the transition in the period-9 slab does not occur between r = 5 and r = 12
pass_fail.verdict_rule: the lattice shows what closure does to the exponent; whether nature's transition is set by a length (this model) or by an acceleration (the RAR) is the discriminating observable to report; the lattice cannot decide it without a calibration of L
